Contractor will be paid for transition costs in accordance with its pricing proposal. Transition costs are defined as all costs expended during the transition period that are necessary and reasonable to assume operation, maintenance, and responsibility for the system. The Contractor’s transition plan must permit sufficient time for a deliberate and orderly turnover of the NIMS system but must not exceed 90 days. The Contractor must participate in technical discussions with the outgoing contractor for the purpose of ensuring a smooth transfer. If the Contractor does not initiate and comply in accordance with transition activities as outlined in its transition plan, any extra costs arising from the delay in meeting the timeline will be the Contractor's responsibility. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. Indien dat niet het geval is (dus niet beschikbaar), voegt de buitenlandse inschrijven een verklaring op eer toe met vermelding van het bedrag van de omzet van het laatst goedkeurde boekjaar. De inschrijver moet kunnen aantonen dat hij de gevraagde dienstverlening kan garanderen, met inbegrip van de beschikbaarheid van profielen, die het Nederlands machtig zijn en die op verzoek van de dienst ICT fysiek aanwezig kunnen zijn op de FIT-locatie te Brussel.” De documenten in het kader van de beoordeling op basis van de gunningscriteria (A.5), met name: Stuk 7 Per profiel, een overzichtslijst met de aantallen van alle medewerkers conform het formulier dat als bijlage bij dit bestek gaat (zie bijlage 6); Per profiel, voor 3 van de beschi

Verantwoordelijkheid Team member //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// Bijlage 10 Pagina 4 van 51 Class 2 - Internal III.2.1.2 Adviseur Informatieveiligheid Functie Adviseur Informatieveiligheid Taakomschrijving De opdrachten van de Adviseur Informatieveiligheid situeren zich in het domein van ICT Security, Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery, Risk Assessment en veiligheidsnormen (ISO2700x), ICT governance & performance en ICT assurance en het Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG) (General Data Protection Regulation - GDPR) domein. Hij/zij evalueert problemen inzake informatieveiligheid, stelt veiligheidsbeleidslijnen op en brengt adviezen uit. Hij/zij verricht conformiteitsassessments t.o.v. het veiligheidsbeleid en wettelijke verplichtingen. Deze kunnen een operationeel, tactisch en strategisch karakter hebben. Hij/zij begeleidt veranderingsprocessen op organisatorisch, technisch en procesniveau. Hij/zij werkt op basis van risico-inschatting en risicoanalyse. Hij/zij leidt projecten m.b.t. informatieveiligheid. Hij/zij stelt heldere documenten op bestemd

INBEGREPEN PRIJSELEMENTEN (ART. 32, § 3 KB PLAATSING) Naast de elementen opgesomd in artikel 32, §3 KB Plaatsing zijn de volgende elementen inbegrepen in de eenheidsprijzen en globale prijzen: - de administratie en het secretariaat; - de verplaatsing, het vervoer en de verzekering; - de documentatie die met de diensten verband houdt; - de levering van documenten of stukken die inherent zijn aan de uitvoering; - de verpakkingen; - de voor het gebruik noodzakelijke vorming; - in voorkomend geval, de maatregelen die door de wetgeving inzake de veiligheid en de gezondheid van de werknemers worden opgelegd voor de uitvoering van hun werk; - desgevallend de kosten m.b.t. intellectuele rechten (zie B.4. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. sla_onsite.text: ivilegiums prinsipp. Privilegerte kontoer skal være særskilt sikret, og løsningen skal støtte opprettelse, endring, sperring og periodisk kontroll av tilganger. Må-krav 3.8 Løsningen skal støtte effektiv administrasjon av brukere og tilganger. Må-krav Side 15 av 20 Løsningen skal ha funksjonalitet for opprettelse, endring, sperring og deaktiver- ing av brukere og tilganger. Leverandøren skal svare ja dersom dette støttes i standardløsningen. Leverandøren skal beskrive hvordan løsningen kan inte- greres med Kundens identitetsforvaltning for opprettelse, endring, sperring og deaktivering av brukere og tilganger. 3.9 Løsningen skal logge oppslag, lesing, opprettelse, endring, utskrift, eksport og administrativ tilgang til pasientopplysninger. Loggen skal vise hvem som utførte handlingen, tidspunkt, pasient eller data, og hvilken handling som ble utført. Autoriserte representanter for Kunden skal kunne søke i, filtrere og eksportere logger uten bistand fra leverandøren. Loggene skal beskyttes mot uautorisert endring og sletting. Må-krav 3.10 Helse- og personopplysninger skal krypteres under overføring og ved lagring ved bruk av anerkjente og oppdaterte metoder. Leverandøren skal ha dokumenterte rutiner for sikker oppbevaring, tilgang, utskifting og tilbakekalling av kryptering

Endringer som påvirker arbeidsflyt, integrasjoner eller tilgjengelighet, skal nor- malt varsles minst ti virkedager på forhånd og følges av oppdatert dokumen- tasjon. Sikkerhetskritiske oppdateringer kan gjennomføres med kortere varsel. Må-krav 4.5 Leverandøren skal levere periodiske rapporter over tilgjengelighet, hendelser, responstider, åpne supportsaker, gjennomførte endringer og eventuelle avvik fra SLA. Kunden skal ved behov kunne kreve oppfølgingsmøte om drift og tjenestek- valitet. Må-krav 4.6 Ved avtalens opphør skal leverandøren bistå med kontrollert overgang til Kunden eller ny leverandør. Kundens data, metadata, logger og nødvendig dokumentasjon skal utleveres i dokumenterte, strukturerte og lesbare formater. Tilgang skal opprettholdes i avtalt overgangsperiode, og sletting skal dokumenteres etter Kundens godkjen- ning. Må-krav 4.7 Kvalitet Side 17 av 20 Forbedrede tjenestenivåer: Leverandøren skal beskrive tilbudte tjenestenivåer utover minimumskravene. Legevakten er lokalisert i Kombinasjonsbygget ved Sykehuset i Levanger, adresse: Kirkegata 2D, 7600 Levanger. ILL har behov for å anskaffe en ny elektronisk pasientjournalløsning (EPJ) som en skybasert tjeneste. Formålet er å erstatte dagens løsning, som ikke støtter skybasert drift, med en moderne og fremtidsrettet løsning som gir bedre til

nde drift/support av ferdig løsning etter ferdig implementering. Kontrakten er tenkt være en løpende tjenesteavtale. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Nothing in these Rules is intended to give any person who is not a Party any right to enforce any provision of the Rules, or to confer any legally protected benefit on any such person. Severability. If at any time any provision of the Rules becomes illegal, invalid or unenforceable in any respect under the law of any jurisdiction, neither the legality, validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions of the Rules nor the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision under the law of any other jurisdiction shall in any way be affected or impaired thereby. Binding effect of determinations. Any certification or determination by NODES of a rate or amount under the Rules shall, in the absence of manifest error and except as otherwise set out in the Rules, be conclusive evidence of the matters to which it relates. In any proceedings arising out of or in connection with the Rules, the entries made in the accounts maintained by NODES will be prima facie evidence of the matters to which they relate. Non-waiver of rights. No failure of a party to exercise, nor any delay on its part in exercising, any of its rights (in whole or in part) under the Rules shall operate as a waiver of the party’s rights or remedies upon that or any subsequent occasion. New technologies, in the area of both consumption and production, such as solar panels, heat pumps, electric cars, batteries, etc. will bring challenges to the distribution system: namely, handling volatility in consumption and high peak loads on specific parts of this grid. Complementary to its usual methods (such as investment), Fluvius System Operator cv wants to develop flexibility and ancillary services as a methodology to keep the quality of its service high. C.1.2 Scope of Work The Contractor must provide operations and maintenance support for the NIMS/CMIS system, provide quality assurance and quality control, provide security compliance and ensure uninterrupted system availability. This effort also requires the vendor to serve as a SME and provide support with system architecture, software recommendations, system design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation for a new system to support NISC V contract requirements when required. Contractor will maintain NIMS/CMIS security certifications required to operate the software and its associated server hardware. The Contractor must also provide transition support to any potential new vendor at the contract’s end. C.1.3 Objectives The objectives of the NEST’s Scope of Work are to provide the following support: • Operation and Maintenance of the NIMS/CMIS System: o Enhancement to NIMS systems, KITT Financial Database (KFDB) reporting database, and NISC Invoice Approval Tool (NIAT) using existing technology stack to support business process requirements as and when required by NISC PMO; 693KA9-26-R-00003 Part I – The Schedule Section C – Statement of Work 7

ed; o Maintain CMIS, which is in-active. Vendor must be able to run and provide reports as requested by Project Management Office (PMO), Contracting Officer Representative (COR), and Contracting Officer (CO); o System upgrades include developing and integrating financial dashboard (NED: NISC Enterprise Database) from the NISC IV Prime Contractor’s financial systems into NIMS based on requirements provided by the PMO to provide financial metrics such as Task Order EAC (Estimate at Completion), ETC (Estimate to Complete), Earned Value Measurement (EVM), and other financial metrics; o Support and maintain the current level of security certification by interfacing with the FAA Cyber security organization and conducting the necessary security threat detection and system scans, resolution of cyber security issues and the associated updates to documentation such as System Characterization Document (SCD), System Security Plan (SSP), and Plan of Action & Milestones (POAM) fixes, and any other documents required by FAA’s cybersecurity team; o Comply with FAA IT policies and guidelines to include PIV/My Access security authentication layer integrated into NIMS/CMIS; o Provide data extracts and reports from NIMS/CMIS to meet data call requirements o Transition-out NIMS/CMIS support to

The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Technical Operations ATC Facilities Directorate, Implementation Services Group (AJW-2131) has a requirement for technical support to Technical Operations programs. Technical support consists of Information Technology (IT) support, independent quality assurance, quality control, and application lifecycle operations and maintenance support for the NAS Implementation Support Contract (NISC) Information Management System (NIMS)/Contract Management Information System (CMIS). The FAA requires support throughout life cycle of contract management including, but are not limited to, task order management, financial transaction management, invoice life cycle management, reporting, award fee processing, and data integration with FAA and prime-contractor systems. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Gewenst opleidingsniveau Licentiaats-/masterniveau of graduaats-/bachelorniveau, met minimaal 3 jaar relevante praktijkervaring als CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach. sla_onsite.text: ffelsen gjennomføres i henhold til lov om offentlige anskaffelser (LOA) og anskaffelsesforskriften (FOA) del I. Kostnader ved utarbeidelse av tilbud Eventuelle kostnader leverandøren har ved utarbeidelse av tilbudet dekkes av leverandøren selv. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Leverandøren kan bli bedt om å levere en sladdet versjon av tilbudet dersom det fremsettes innsynskrav. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. Nothing in these Rules is intended to give any person who is not a Party any right to enforce any provision of the Rules, or to confer any legally protected benefit on any such person. Severability. If at any time any provision of the Rules becomes illegal, invalid or unenforceable in any respect under the law of any jurisdiction, neither the legality, validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions of the Rules nor the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision under the law of any other jurisdiction shall in any way be affected or impaired thereby. Binding effect of determinations. Any certification or determination by NODES of a rate or amount under the Rules shall, in the absence of manifest error and except as otherwise set out in the Rules, be conclusive evidence of the matters to which it relates. In any proceedings arising out of or in connection with the Rules, the entries made in the accounts maintained by NODES will be prima facie evidence of the matters to which they relate. Non-waiver of rights. No failure of a party to exercise, nor any delay on its part in exercising, any of its rights (in whole or in part) under the Rules shall operate as a waiver of the party’s rights or remedies upon that or any subsequent occasion. New technologies, in the area of both consumption and production, such as solar panels, heat pumps, electric cars, batteries, etc. will bring challenges to the distribution system: namely, handling volatility in consumption and high peak loads on specific parts of this grid. Complementary to its usual methods (such as investment), Fluvius System Operator cv wants to develop flexibility and ancillary services as a methodology to keep the quality of its service high.
